- Progressive completed its rollout of the Snapshot Pro program, combining its commercial telematics platforms Snapshot ProView and Smart Haul [1]. - Amazon and alternative parcel carriers continued to expand market share and parcel volume during the first half of 2026 [2]. This growth expands Nirvana's immediate addressable market for last-mile commercial auto insurance [2].
